items.stem: If a student wants to use a mirror to create an image that is smaller than the object and always erect, which mirror should he use?

What happens to the image formed by a concave mirror when the object is placed very close to the mirror?
Which type of mirror is used in the reflectors of torches and headlights?

What kind of image does a convex mirror always form?
